logger_severity.description: Logging severity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL)

logger_debuglevel.description: Debug level (0–99); higher values produce more verbose logs

control_socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket for KEA control agent communication

server_id_type.description: Server ID type. Use 'LLT' (Link-layer Address plus Time) or 'EN' (Enterprise Number)

server_id_enterprise_id.description: Enterprise number for EN-type server ID (e.g., IANA-assigned value like 5642)

server_id_identifier.description: Identifier string or 'auto' to auto-generate from interface MAC(s)

reconfigure_wait_seconds.description: Seconds the server waits before reconfiguring after receiving a SIGHUP

interfaces.description: List of interface names (e.g., ['eth0']) for DHCPv6 traffic

interfaces_re_detect.description: If true, re-scan network interfaces at reconfigure time

lease_database_type.description: Lease backend: 'memfile' (file-based) or 'mysql', 'postgresql', 'cql' for SQL backends

lease_database_memfile_name.description: Path to the IPv6 lease file for memfile backend

lease_database_memfile_persist.description: If true, write leases to disk (needed for restart persistence)

lease_database_memfile_lfc_interval.description: Lease file cleanup (LFC) interval in seconds; 0 disables

lease_database_password.description: Database password (for SQL backends); leave empty if using system auth

lease_database_port.description: Database port (for SQL backends; default for PostgreSQL)

pool.description: IPv6 address range or single address in pool (e.g., '2001:db8:1::10 - 2001:db8:1::ff')

name.description: Option name per RFC 8415 or IANA registry (e.g., 'dns-servers')

data.description: Option value as string (e.g., comma-separated IPs for dns-servers)

code.description: Option code (numeric override if not using name)

csv_format.description: If true, interpret data as CSV format

du_id.description: DUID (hex string without 0x prefix) of the client device unit

preferred_lifetime.description: Preferred lifetime (seconds) for addresses in this subnet

declined_leases_detection.description: Enable detection and logging of declined addresses (e.g., NAK'd by client)

cache_threshold.description: Cache threshold (0.0–1.0) before flushing leases; 0 disables caching

cache_max_age.description: Max age (seconds) for cached entries; 0 means unlimited

subnets.description: List of IPv6 subnets to serve

dhcp_ddns_enable_updates.description: If true, enable dynamic DNS updates (RFC 4704)

dhcp_ddns_qualifying_suffix.description: Suffix to append to hostnames for DDNS (e.g., 'lan.' or 'example.com')

dhcp_ddns_server_ip.description: Primary DDNS server IP (for TSIG-authenticated updates)

dhcp_ddns_server_port.description: DDNS server port (usually 53 or 5300 for TSIG)

dns_server_ips.description: IP addresses of authoritative DNS servers

dhcp_ddns_dns_regions.description: List of DNS regions for DDNS configuration (optional)

parameters.description: JSON string of parameters to pass to the hook library

hooks_libraries.description: List of hook libraries to load at startup (e.g., for lease commands)

user_context_comment.description: Free-form comment stored in user-context for documentation
